A <b>Tool Synergy</b> is when two [[Tools]] or a Tool and a [[Crest]] work together to produce a novel effect, altering either of their default mechanics.

{{Disclaimer
|This page does not list combined effects of two Tools that are to be expected, such as [[Pollip Pouch|Pollip Pouch's]] [[Pollip Pouch#Usefulness|venom]] effect applying to {{CrestSlot|Red|s}}.
}}
